title: AnyList Grocery List Weekly Shopping Time Trend
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anylist:grocery shopping_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(shopping_minutes) as avg_duration, max(shopping_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst shopping time for AnyList grocery list events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture shopping_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average shopping time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether AnyList grocery list tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
